profile.learning_style: 喜欢通过项目实战学习，不喜欢重复听很多理论。
profile.mentor_note: Eric is building Atlas as a long-term AI research mentor robot.

Arduino.note: Eric can already use Arduino for hardware feedback, LEDs, servo, and OLED.

Python.note: Eric can use Python for JSON, file reading and writing, OpenCV, and project management logic.

OpenCV.note: Eric can use OpenCV for camera detection and face presence checking.

YOLO.note: Eric has basic direction for object detection but still needs more practice.

ROS2.note: Eric has not started ROS2 yet. This is important for future robot systems.
